title: Ochiq kosmosda 10 kun bo'lib, tirik qaytgan hayvon qaysi?
hook: Bu jonzot 10 kun ochiq kosmosda bo'ldi.

scenes.text: 2007 yilda Yevropa olimlari kichik jonzotlarni sun'iy yo'ldoshda 10 kun ochiq kosmosda qoldirishdi.
U yerda havo yo'q, Quyoshning ultrabinafsha nurlari esa juda kuchli.
Yerga qaytgach, jonzotlarning bir qismi tirik chiqdi. Bular tardigradlar edi.
Ular taxminan yarim millimetr, suv ayig'i deb ham ataladi.
Qizig'i, ulardan ba'zilari keyin tuxum qo'ydi, tuxumlardan bolalar chiqdi.
scenes.keywords: moss close up water drops macro

description:
2007 yilda FOTON-M3 missiyasida quritilgan tardigradlar 10 kun ochiq kosmosda bo'ldi va ularning bir qismi tirik qaytdi. Ba'zilari keyin tuxum qo'ydi va tuxumlardan bolalar chiqdi.

Siz buni bilarmidingiz? Izohda "ha" yoki "yo'q" deb yozing.
source: Fact-check 2026-11-12 (web search): all claims TRUE, no text change. Jonsson et al., Current Biology, Sept 2008 (Cell Press release): two species of dried tardigrades flew on ESA's FOTON-M3 (launched Sept 2007) and were exposed to open space in low Earth orbit for 10 days. About 68% of one species shielded from the hardest solar UV revived within 30 min of rehydration, many laid eggs that hatched; with full solar UV only a few survived, so 'bir qismi' is correct. Typical length about 0.5 mm. Note: the title question implies tardigrades are the answer; the claim is not stated as 'the only animal', so keep it that way. Sources: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2008/09/080908135906.htm ; https://phys.org/news/2008-09-space-not-so-final-frontier.html ; https://www.photonics.com/Article.aspx?AID=35602
